# Halocline

> Quality is everything.

Halocline is an inference engine for one NVIDIA Ada GPU (sm_89) and the Qwen4 family. Sparse (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) and dense (Qwen3.8-27B) paths on a single 24 GB RTX 4090.

## Links
- Source: https://github.com/T-Crypt/halocline
- Docs: https://github.com/T-Crypt/halocline/tree/main/docs
- Community runs: https://t-crypt.github.io/halocline/community/
